I have had a set of these Bose speakers in my patio for 7 years now, and they are still as awesome as they were when I installed them.  They provide excellent sound quality, even when playing compressed audio formats.  They also provide stereo imaging that rivals that of premium indoor speakers (I have considered getting some sets of these to use with the surround sound in my living room).
The weather has had very little effect on these speakers over the years, they are slightly faded, and that's about the only sign of age that they show.
Another wonderful quality of these speakers; is that they are non-directional.  Which means that unlike most speakers, you DO NOT have to be in a specific location to hear good quality sound.
So if you are looking for great sounding outdoor speakers, these are simply the best one's available.
